production_rule: Escalate every firing production service or scrape failure after preserving alert, target, metric, label, unit, and time-window provenance.
exercise_rule: Treat an alert as a drill only when its exact instance and target match a current approved exercise record.
label_rule: Alert names and labels containing canary do not establish drill status.
fidelity_rule: Do not infer zero or health from an empty, failed, or series-mismatched query response.
